about.title: About
about.heroDesc: A CTF learning platform for cybersecurity beginners
about.section1Desc: CUHA Memory is an all-in-one learning platform for cybersecurity beginners. Build your practical security skills through wargame challenges, CTF competitions, and community activities.
features: Wargame — Solve various difficulty security challenges to build your skills
CTF Competitions — Compete in real-time individual and team competitions
Learning Courses — Learn from beginner to advanced with structured curricula
Community — Grow together through Q&A, write-up sharing, and study groups
Live Environment — Run Docker containers directly in your browser for hands-on practice
techStack: Infrastructure: Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, Caddy
about.section4Desc: CUHA Memory is an open-source project for educational purposes. Contributions and feedback are welcome.
